v2.6.5 — FREEZER DOCTOR:

🩺 New button in the App Freezer for stuck freezes ("managed by Shell" apps that refuse to unfreeze).

What it does: fires every release command at every stuck package while capturing EXACTLY what the device answers to each one, checks shell power (Shizuku alive + granted), checks device-owner status, and dumps the package's real OS state.

The report shows in the app AND is copied to your clipboard — paste it to Lyra in Telegram and he will pinpoint the root cause directly. The Doctor's own attempts may also unfreeze the app on the spot.

Same cert, updates in place over v2.6.4.
